project_info.name: RRAVI ORGANIC ENTERPRISES
project_info.description: Award-worthy (Awwwards Site-of-the-Day level) multi-page agro/herbal export website combining Apple-like editorial precision with rich botanical warmth.

design_archetype.name: Botanical Apple-Minimalism & Organic Precision
design_archetype.vibe: High-end luxury editorial meets scientific export reliability. Atmospheric deep forest green surfaces, warm sand backgrounds, crisp typography, and vibrant terracotta/amber highlights.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Swiss typography layout with botanical warmth and tactile photography.
Emotion First: Evoke trust, purity, scientific rigor, and natural origin.
Content is King: Line-by-line masked hero reveal, numbered manifesto chapters, and dedicated category storytelling.
Generous Spacing: 2-3x padding to avoid cramped AI template aesthetics.
Tactile Contrast: Dark forest surfaces, glassmorphism overlays, and rich natural photos.

key_interactive_components: Glassmorphism sticky navbar with live active route indicator and quick Request Quote action
Kinetic Hero section with masked line-by-line reveal using Framer Motion
Slow editorial marquee banner with subtle drift effect
Interactive 8-Category Bento Grid with single high-impact stock photo per category and Request Quote trigger
Quote Enquiry Drawer / Modal pre-populated with chosen product category
WhatsApp instant enquiry trigger button with pre-written request message
Comparison table on Why Us page (RRAVI Organic Enterprises vs Standard Export Traders)
Functional enquiry form connected to toast notifications (Sonner)
instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure Lenis smooth scrolling is integrated at top level App component.
Do NOT use transparent headers. Use glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0B2219]/85 border-b border-[#F9F6F0]/10.
Add data-testid attributes on ALL buttons, input fields, navbar links, quote triggers, and form submits.
Support dark and light modes cleanly or use deep organic dark forest green as the default primary theme with warm cream accents.
Inject Sonner Toaster in index.js / App.js for enquiry submit confirmations.
Keep code structured with clear modular components in src/components/ and src/pages/.
